title: Kissner tells Steven Schiff, who launches the Roswell GAO probe

tellings.quote: Uh indeed uh Jay Ander Kissner allegedly in 19 1995 told other New Mexico state rep uh Steven Schiff about this.

plain: In 1995, a New Mexico state representative named J. Andrew Kissner is said to have told another New Mexico lawmaker, Steven Schiff, what he knew, and Schiff then started an inquiry by the GAO, Congress's audit office, into Roswell, the 1947 New Mexico incident many say involved a crashed craft. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels this, saying Kissner "allegedly" passed it on, without naming where he learned it. If true, a state politician's tip lay behind the federal probe of Roswell.
